testcase.name: Scenario: Move a command between the main and expanded areas: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-panel-expansion-source/features/application/ribbon-panel-expansion/ribbon-panel-expansion.feature:167:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Move a command between the main and expanded areas ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open and active ✔ And "Shell" appears in the main area of the 3D Model "Modify" panel ✔ When the user right-clicks "Shell" and selects "Move to Expanded Panel" ✔ Then "Shell" is no longer visible in the main area ✔ When the user opens the "Modify" panel expansion ✔ Then "Shell" appears in the expanded area ✔ When the user right-clicks "Shell" in the expanded area ✔ And the user selects "Move to Main Panel" ✔ Then the expansion closes ✔ And "Shell" appears again in the main area of the "Modify" panel
